🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 30, 2026

Moon, exalted in Taurus, holds a square to the North Node, on the karmic axis in Aquarius. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. From Libra, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. Four weeks ago Mars was still in Cancer: the ground has moved.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is a foreigner in Scorpio and improvises. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Fixed earth: the holding and the held stop differing. It has stood three weeks; by now the cost is known.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you from Scorpio, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Mars in Leo opens a gap you have to step into. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. The Virgo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you and is honoured in Taurus: a generous reading. From Libra, Sun cuts across the appetite. Water that starts things, billed for starting. The trine to Mercury that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Moon squares you from Taurus, and the cost objects. Fixed fire: the grip costs more than the thing. Sun left Virgo four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. Moon trines you from Taurus, meeting no resistance. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Cardinal air: the start and the settlement coincide. Venus has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon in Taurus mirrors you, and the mirror keeps its own figures. Fixed water pays to hold on. A week ago Mars was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Sun sextiles you from Libra: a door left ajar. Mutable fire: two answers, and both are affordable. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Taurus trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Earth moves first here, and first is enough. The trine of a week ago is off it now.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. Moon in Taurus squares you: the price shows before the wish does. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon in Taurus makes room for you, and then waits. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. It arrived inside the last seven days.
